correctness.rationale: Conditioning on m protective co-players, the D and S focal quorum indicators differ exactly at m=M−1, and switching D to S removes one defector. This gives the stated b_m and its Bernstein average. The block through M−1 strictly increases (the pivotal bonus is nonnegative) and the block from M is nondecreasing, even at ω=1. The first block has at least two distinct entries; an identically zero polynomial is impossible. The positive change of variable to t=z/(1−z) preserves multiplicity and gives Descartes' bound of three after zero coefficients are dropped. If the leading nonzero Bernstein sign is positive, there are at most two variations and B starts positive; if negative there are at most three and B starts negative. In both cases alternating crossings give at most one + to − crossing, the necessary and sufficient scalar sign pattern for attraction at an isolated zero. Independent rational evaluation in /workspace/check_frozen_math.py confirms the three disjoint brackets and the exact whole-edge identity A=B+k−(216/125)z(1−z)² in the rational N=4 example. The cubic has no other roots and each is simple. The transverse signs −,−,+ and the tangential signs +,−,+ give saddle, sink, source; the checked invasion eigenvalues at full D and full C are respectively (−121/625,−659/2500) and (−3/5,−7/100). Positivity of the brackets and strict eigenvalue signs persist under small admissible continuous-parameter perturbations at fixed N,M. N=3 gives degree at most two. The uploaded support was inspected, not run; finite arithmetic verifies the witness, not the uniform bound.

value.rationale: An all-size sharp bound controls a natural invariant edge, while the surviving exact witness demonstrates that minimal-size sharpness can coexist with a qualitatively different two-dimensional phase portrait: the high-protection root repels in both directions, a nearby middle root is a genuine sink, and both homogeneous D and C are sinks at the same parameters. Edge tangential dynamics alone cannot distinguish source from saddle. The configuration is hyperbolic and persists, so the distinction is not an isolated arithmetic coincidence or a mere variation of parameters. No basin or full-interior classification is warranted.
